messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-gateway-prod" — symptom=5xx_rate_spike — region=us-central1 — trigger=error-rate > 5% over 1m — PD:PD-8567 — severity: high — link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-8567

pagerbot: autoscroll: paging Samir (oncall) -> Aisha (SRE) -> escalation after 5m if unacked

Samir (oncall): acked the PD alert. I'm on it. Starting triage.

Aisha (SRE): thanks. quick question — is this global or single-region? Grafana shows a sharp spike in us-central1 only.

Samir (oncall): confirm single-region. 5xx mainly 502/504 from edge -> gateway upstream.

Jules (platform): I'm seeing a corresponding increase in upstream connection resets on the gateway nodes (nginx) — likely keepalive / connection pool exhaustion.

Logan (infra): checking infra autoscaler and NLB health. No obvious instance churn. Backend pods still at desired count.

Samir (oncall): running the runbook query now: `sum(rate(http_responses_total{service="gateway",status=~"5..",region="us-central1"}[1m])) by (status)`

Aisha (SRE): output shows 502:250rps / 504:120rps. Error ratio ~6.8% on 1m window.

Jules (platform): pulling pod logs from gateway-ssr-*. seeing repeated `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `connection reset by peer` patterns. Could be overloaded TCP connections to runtime.

Samir (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) increase gateway replicas by +30% 2) toggle keepalive timeout to 60s on nginx 3) warm KV cache fallback? 4) if still bad, rollback last canary. Any objections?

Logan (infra): increasing replicas now (k8s HPA bump through manual scale): `kubectl -n infra scale deploy/gateway --replicas=13` -> scaling triggered.

Aisha (SRE): I'll push a config tweak to reduce upstream keepalive reuse to force fresher connections (nginx config): `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection ""; keepalive_timeout 60;` applying via rolling restart.

Jules (platform): flag: the last canary (v2.7.3-canary) was promoted to 10% traffic earlier today. If connection semantics changed in that release it could explain regression. Can we route traffic away from canary temporarily?

Samir (oncall): routing 100% to stable for now. `deploy-router set-weight inference-gateway-prod v2.7.3-canary 0` -> confirmed.

Eva (CS): any customer impact? we have two customers reporting increased 502s via support tickets. I'll draft a short status msg once we identify scope.

Aisha (SRE): additional observation: KV cache hit rate dropped ~40% around spike — potential cache eviction/warmup issue exacerbating load. Warming cache might help throughput.

Jules (platform): launching a targeted cache prefill job for top prefixes now (job: `cache-prefill --top=5000 --parallel=8`). ETA ~2m.

Logan (infra): NLB health checks are OK, but TCP connex per-node approaching system limits. Kernel net.core.somaxconn/opt tuning could help; but that's more invasive. Prefer app-level mitigations first.

Samir (oncall): after scale + route -> stable, 5xx rate dropped to ~2.1% in last 30s. Still seeing occasional spikes.

Aisha (SRE): good sign. keepalive tweak applied on 6/6 gateways; rolling restart completed.

Jules (platform): cache prefill job completed, KV hit rate climbing back to normal.

Samir (oncall): looks like combination of canary + cold cache + connection reuse triggered capacity oversubscription. Next step: hold canary, monitor 15m, schedule full rollback postmortem if needed.

Eva (CS): posted initial message to customers impacted: "We're investigating elevated error rates for inference requests in us-central1. We've applied mitigations and will update within 30 minutes." (thumbsup emoji)

pagerbot: escalation timer cancelled (alert acknowledged and mitigations applied).

Aisha (SRE): monitoring logs for 10m window. If errors > 3% again, escalate to eng-runtime for deeper investigation.

Logan (infra): small note for postmortem: capture kernel socket stats, per-node fd usage, and nginx upstream timing. I'll snapshot `/proc/net/sockstat` from nodes.

Samir (oncall): marking incident as monitored. PD incident PD-8567 status -> acknowledged -> mitigations applied -> observation period. Moving to handoff in 20m if stable.

Jules (platform): creating follow-up ticket: INF-6721 — "investigate gateway keepalive semantics + canary promotion safeguards" and assign to eng-runtime + platform.

Eva (CS): will update customers in 20m with current status and ask for any further reports.

Samir (oncall): 20m check-in: error rate holding ~1.2%, below threshold. Proceeding to handoff to oncall rotation (Aisha primary next hour). I'll leave thread open for 1h.

Aisha (SRE): acked handoff. I'll keep watching, will escalate if anything creeps up. Planning a quick postmortem draft after stabilization.

Samir (oncall): thanks all. Quick timeline to record: 00:00 PD fired; 00:01 ack; 00:02 scale + set-weight away from canary; 00:05 keepalive tweak + rolling restart; 00:07 cache prefill done; 00:25 stable under threshold.

Jules (platform): capturing config diffs and canary rollout logs for PM/eng-runtime review.

Logan (infra): saved node snapshots and handed to evidence bucket s3://redwood-incidents/pd-8567/

IncidentBot: PD-8567 -> status: acknowledged -> mitigations applied -> monitoring -> no active page.

Samir (oncall): closing immediate page; filing follow-up and scheduling postmortem. Thanks everyone.
